resources.string: Setup was interrupted; you can retry
Couldn’t unpack the environment; please reinstall agentreins-moblie: %1$s
Not supported on this device (needs arm64)
Not enough space: needs %1$d MB (%2$d MB free)
The mika command is missing (incomplete package)
Environment files are incomplete; you can reset it in Settings → Advanced
Setup didn’t finish; you can retry
By default agentreins-moblie works with files and runs scripts offline. With this on, scripts can use the network (for example to look up papers or maps) and could also send out files from the chat.
This device can’t keep scripts offline: agentreins-moblie can only work with files and run scripts when “Allow scripts to go online” is on

Deletes the environment agentreins-moblie uses for files and scripts, plus the files created in each chat (including ones you attached), then sets it up again automatically. Chats and settings aren’t affected.
For when something’s wrong: deletes it and sets it up again
